paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма показва GPU паметта, използвана от различни методи за фино настройване на езикови модели. Хоризонталната ос представя категориите методи за настройване: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA и Ours, подредени по произволен ред. Вертикалната ос показва стойностите на GPU паметта в гигабайти (GB), с диапазон от 0 до 60, с равномерна скала на интервали от 10. Най-високият стълб показва Full FT с приблизително 60 GB GPU памет, докато най-ниският стълб представлява метода Ours с около 10 GB. Stълбовете за MTL-FT и TAG са приблизително на 40 GB и 20 GB съответно. Stълбовете за LoRA и QLoRA показват приблизително 20 GB и 40 GB GPU памет. Методът Ours е визуално оцветен в зелено, а останалите методи са оцветени в оранжево.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage, in gigabytes (GB), for different fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the method categories: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels displayed in intervals of 20.  Each category is represented by a single, orange bar except for “Ours”, which is represented by a green bar. The tallest bar corresponds to “Full FT”, with an approximate value of 62 GB. The shortest bar is “Ours”, with an approximate value of 23 GB. “MTL-FT” has a value of approximately 40 GB, “TAG” has a value of around 30 GB, “LoRA” is around 14 GB, and “QLoRA” is approximately 38 GB. The bars are not sorted, and the final bar representing "Ours" is visually differentiated by its green color.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt den GPU-Speicherbedarf verschiedener Methoden dar, die beim Feintuning von Sprachmodellen verwendet werden. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Methoden – Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA und Ours – die in keiner bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet sind, während die vertikale Achse den GPU-Speicher in Gigabyte (GB) darstellt. Die vertikale Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 60 GB, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in 20-GB-Intervallen angegeben sind. Es gibt sechs einzelne orangefarbene und grüne Balken. Der Balken für „Full FT“ erreicht einen Wert von etwa 62 GB, der Balken für „MTL-FT“ einen Wert von etwa 38 GB, der Balken für „TAG“ einen Wert von etwa 40 GB, der Balken für „LoRA“ einen Wert von etwa 20 GB, der Balken für „QLoRA“ einen Wert von etwa 14 GB und der Balken für „Ours“ einen Wert von etwa 22 GB. Der Balken für „Ours“ ist grün, die restlichen Balken sind orangefarben.
